title: When a Clueless First-Person Shooter Player Falls into Another World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Schwarz, a dedicated VR shooter gamer, falls off the map mid-match and wakes in a world of swords and sorcery, where the locals call him a 'dud' for lacking magic until his modern rifle proves stronger than spells (Seven Seas blurb via AniList; ANN). His first encounter is rescuing a woman about to be 'ravaged by goblins' (ANN). Manga of a light novel, five volumes and on hiatus in Japan (MU); Seven Seas rates it 15+ (ANN).
life_message: Skill, preparation and technology let an outsider prove his worth where he was written off.

content.note: Rifle combat against monsters is the core appeal (blurb, ANN); MU Armed Combat, Goblins, Kidnapping.
Woman threatened by goblins, implied sexual threat (ANN) and MU Attempted Rape; 'a little prurience' (ANN); MU Harem genre.
Firearms shown as the solution; game-like framing of killing.
Built on FPS game mechanics (ANN; MU Game Elements).
